import java.util.Scanner;

public class Main {
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        int n = sc.nextInt();
        int k = sc.nextInt();
        double[] p = new double[n];
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            p[i] = sc.nextDouble();
        }

        double[][] c = new double[21][21];
        c[0][0] = 1.0;
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            c[i][0] = 1.0;
            for (int j = 1; j <= i; j++) {
                c[i][j] = c[i - 1][j - 1] + c[i - 1][j];
            }
        }

        int maxMask = 1 << 20;
        int[] sz = new int[maxMask];
        double[] sum = new double[maxMask];
        int totalMasks = 1 << n;
        for (int mask = 0; mask < totalMasks; mask++) {
            sz[mask] = 0;
            sum[mask] = 0.0;
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                if (((mask >> j) & 1) == 1) {
                    sz[mask]++;
                    sum[mask] += p[j];
                }
            }
        }

        double[] coef = new double[21];
        for (int i = k - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
            coef[i] = 1.0 - coef[i];
            for (int j = 1; i - j >= 0; j++) {
                coef[i - j] += c[n - 1 - i + j][j] * coef[i];
            }
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            double ans = 0.0;
            if (p[i] > 0.005) {
                for (int mask = 0; mask < totalMasks; mask++) {
                    if (((mask >> i) & 1) == 1) continue;
                    if (sz[mask] >= k) continue;
                    ans += coef[sz[mask]] / (1.0 - sum[mask]);
                }
            }
            System.out.printf("%.12f ", p[i] * ans);
        }
        System.out.println();
        sc.close();
    }
}
